methodology: Each measurement run = warm-up + N iterations on a single substrate region. Warm-up iterations are discarded (substrate cold-start signal at start of run only). Cold-start is measured as time-to-first-Capsule-execution from capsulefile-finalize. Exec is measured as exec-call to exec-return. Destroy is measured as destroy-call to AuditProof-emission. Total = cold-start + exec + destroy. Per-iteration timings are collected; p50/p95/p99 are computed via sorted-position percentiles (TDigest unnecessary at N <= 10000).
disclaimer: Cold-start measurements are structural facts captured under the stated infrastructure revision. Customer SLA expectations are determined by the customer's own pilot evaluation; Nanorix publishes these measurements as reference, not as service-level commitment. Whether these latencies are acceptable for the customer's use case is a customer judgment.
